title: Native 内存泄漏工具链：heapprofd、malloc_debug、Perfetto
key_conclusions: heapprofd is the first-line native allocation profiler for sampled stack growth and timeline analysis.
malloc_debug is stronger but heavier, so it should be used for targeted reproduction, exact backtraces, guard checks, or cases where heapprofd is insufficient.
Perfetto connects native allocation growth with scenario markers, threads, frames, GC, and system pressure, while meminfo/showmap/smaps/fd provide the memory bill.
Native leak acceptance requires allocation stack, Native Heap bucket, mapping delta, fd/shared-buffer state, and replayed product behavior to improve together.
shallow_points: The article does not include a real heapprofd trace or malloc_debug leak report from a target device.
It does not validate concrete heapprofd config syntax or malloc_debug properties across Android versions and ROMs.
It does not include a runnable native leak sample with before/after traces.
It does not show a real Perfetto timeline correlating native allocation growth with jank, GC, or pressure.
